Normalize attachments').item.json;const parent=attachment.knowledgeItem;const c=attachment._govchat;const t=parent.translation?.content||{};const title=String(t.title||parent.title||'');const attachmentName=String(attachment.filename||attachment.name||'attachment');const extracted=String($json.data||$json.body||$json.text||'').trim();if(!extracted)return [];const payload={source:'topdesk',source_id:String(parent.id)+':'+String(attachment.id),knowledge_item_id:String(parent.id),attachment_id:String(attachment.id),attachment_name:attachmentName,number:parent.number||null,title:title+' - '+attachmentName,content:[title,attachmentName,extracted].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n'),visible:parent.visibility?.sspVisibility==='VISIBLE',url:c.publicKnowledgeItemUrl?c.publicKnowledgeItemUrl.replace(/\/$/,'')+'?unid='+encodeURIComponent(parent.id):null};const stableUuid=s=>{let h1=0x811c9dc5,h2=0x9e3779b9;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h1=Math.imul(h1^s.charCodeAt(i),0x01000193);h2=Math.imul(h2+s.charCodeAt(i),0x85ebca6b);}const hex=(n)=>('00000000'+(n>>>0).toString(16)).slice(-8);const raw=(hex(h1)+hex(h2)+hex(Math.imul(h1^h2,0xc2b2ae35))+hex(Math.imul(h2^h1,0x27d4eb2f))).split('');raw[12]='5';raw[16]=((parseInt(raw[16],16)&3)|8).toString(16);const v=raw.join('');return v.slice(0,8)+'-'+v.slice(8,12)+'-'+v.slice(12,16)+'-'+v.slice(16,20)+'-'+v.slice(20);};return [{json:{...c,pointId:stableUuid(String(parent.id)+':'+String(attachment.id)),payload,embeddingText:payload.content}}];
